name: Inframark

documented_statements: View and pay online after registering with the security code (top right box on the water bill) and email; create user ID and password
After registration: option to enroll in eBill or autopay; paper bill continues unless enrolled in paperless
Online: credit/debit card convenience fee 3% of payment; electronic check convenience fee $1.00
Automatic bank draft or credit card recurring payments are set up in the portal
Bank online bill pay uses the payment ID (top right box on the bill), e.g. 10123-0000123456
Mail: ATTN Your MUD District, P.O. Box 3264, Houston, TX 77253-3264; late fee applies after the due date
Regional water authority fee appears on bills (Greater Houston subsidence districts)

source_conflicts_and_limits: Operator FAQ publishes $1 eCheck and 3% card fee; zero card minimum is a local assumption because no minimum is published
Per-district policy exceptions unverified; this runtime represents the operator portal catalog record, not all 212 associated billers
AutoPay draft timing is undocumented; the local rule drafts on the due date
Scheduled (future-dated) payments are a synthetic local feature; the source portal scheduling screen was not observed
Shared Starnik client supports reconstruction, not independent private behavioral fidelity
Account personas, invoices, statements, delivery preferences, payment settlement, rounding and wallet continuation are synthetic
www.inframark.com returned HTTP 403 to non-browser fetches on 2026-10-11; evidence uses the 2026-10-05 browser capture
Original scripts excluded; source asset completeness and responsive menus remain unfinished
unfinished: District-specific fees, late-fee amounts and statement layouts
Phone (IVR) and mail payment channels (documented, out of scope)
